worktree.setup: effigy skill run --path "${NORTHSTAR_SKILL_PATH:-$HOME/.agents/skills/northstar}" paseo:worktree -- prepare && effigy skill run --path "${NORTHSTAR_SKILL_PATH:-$HOME/.agents/skills/northstar}" paseo:worktree -- link

title.instructions: Name the bounded Swallowtail outcome in a short title. Use card or contract language when a governing Northstar card exists.

branchName.instructions: Use worker/<short-kebab-case-outcome> for implementation lanes. Keep the worker/ prefix. Target pull requests at main.

commitMessage.instructions: Use a Conventional Commit subject: <type>(<scope>): <imperative outcome>. Common types are feat, fix, docs, and test. Omit the scope when it adds no signal.

pullRequest.instructions: Lead with the shipped outcome. Name the governing Northstar card or contract when one exists, list validation evidence, and state unresolved items. Do not claim merge authority.
